title: Planning run test decomposition
description: Objective: split the oversized planning-run reducer test without weakening its behavioral proof. Deliverable: packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-test-fixtures.ts owns deterministic hashes/witness/state/command/error helpers; planning-run-reducer.test.ts retains creation, readiness, ownership, proposal, and submission-finalization coverage; new planning-run-authority.test.ts owns approval, activation, cancellation, concurrency, version-ceiling, and exhaustive lifecycle coverage. Hard dependency: commit bcdc2f6 and the stable planning-contract.js facade. NOT in scope: production edits, new behavior, renamed/skipped cases, or reduced assertions. Owned paths: packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-reducer.test.ts, packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-test-fixtures.ts, packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-authority.test.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: Every existing planning-run test case and assertion is preserved exactly once across the two test files; no skip/only/todo or assertion loosening is introduced.
The shared fixture module contains only deterministic test construction/assertion helpers and exports no production API.
All three files are <=250 physical lines and test ordering does not create shared mutable state.
The focused core typecheck and test command exits 0 with production files unchanged.
taskRails: Refactor-only: preserve public types, stable error codes, check precedence, event/result ordering, deep freezing, and all observable reducer behavior.
Do not weaken, skip, rename, or delete behavioral assertions merely to make the split pass.
Every changed or new production/test TypeScript file in this task must be <=250 physical lines with LF/CRLF counted equivalently.
Use TDD/characterization and commit only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, merge, reset, or stash.
